text:
olga: deploybot promotion stuck: release-check failed on preflight for canary-2026.03.18. CI shows an artifact-index integrity mismatch when fetching the wheel. change window closes in ~90m — decision needed (pin last-good vs rerun with cache-clear).

deploy-bot: Automated: Promotion paused for canary-2026.03.18 -> preflight failed (artifact-index-integrity). See CI job: https://ci.redwood.example/350123

jon: can you paste the failing log?

maya: paste snippet:
```
ERROR: Artifact integrity check failed
expected checksum: abc123def
found: def456789
fetch source: s3://ci-artifacts/2026/03/18/wheels/pkg-1.2.3.whl
```

maya: One runner returned 504 from artifact-proxy while others completed; smells like a stale index or a concurrent reupload.

lee: If it's an index/hash mismatch, re-running with cache-clear might fix it, but reruns could amplify load. We have a tight change window — my preference is manual pin to last-known-good to keep release on schedule.

sarah: Is this blocking any external customers right now or just internal canary?

olga: Just internal canary at the moment. We want to promote to prod tonight if possible. Pinning buys time to investigate without blowing the window.

jon: I can start a rerun with CLEAR_CACHE=true on a single runner to minimize load. Expect ~20m.

maya: Also check registry insert logs — I think there was a reupload around the same time as index update. Could be an indexing race.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by CI:preflight. Current candidate sha: f1e2d3a4. Last-known-good promoted sha: c9b8a7b6 (promoted 2026-03-17).

lee: Proposal: manual promote c9b8a7b6 to unblock. Meanwhile run the rerun with cache-clear to validate the candidate and root cause.

olga: +1 to manual promote. I will pin the promo tag to c9b8a7b6 and open a follow-up to debug the index race. Will notify release lead.

sarah: Please add a release-note flag mentioning we pinned and will reattempt later. :thumbsup:

jon: kicked off rerun with CLEAR_CACHE=true — job id 350123-R2. I'll post results when done.

olga: Pinning now. Deploybot, please perform manual promote to c9b8a7b6.

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by olga. Executing promote(c9b8a7b6) -> promoted to prod-canary. :rocket:

maya: Rerun passed on the cleared runner but second runner still fails intermittently; looks like proxy-cache TTL staleness. Opening an incident for eng-infra to sweep artifact indexes.

olga: Thanks. We'll hold the pinned image for the next release window. If the rerun fully greens before window close and release lead concurs, we'll consider re-promote.

jon: Job 350123-R2 completed: PASS (cleared-runner). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/350123-R2/log

lee: Action items noted: 1) incident for registry/index race and proxy TTL 2) consistency sweep + migration plan 3) postmortem if we see recurrence. Tagging eng-infra + release-lead. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olga: closing the thread for now — thanks all.
